In preparation for my twenty-first birthday I acquired some 1mg blotters of 2C-D. After making my usual pre hand preparations such as who I'll be with, location, how I feel, etc., I stuck one blotter under my tongue and tried not to swallow any spit. (Come to find later it works better buccally.)
T+0:12, I can start to feel it spread through my body like a warmth. My cue to abandon the television and put on some music.
T+0:21 is when my thought process shifted into a new gear and I began to lose focus. Slight visual distortions but no real visual activity for the duration. Floating thoughts prove helpful for what research I can pull on 2C-D.
T+0:30-1:45 Was spent doubled over a garbage bag retching from some discomfort of chips and dip eaten with disregard just prior to dosing. Afterwards I laid down on my couch with music and notebook and let the trip flow. A recurring feeling that I had passed the trial and was now free to explore myself. Like tribal views of expelling the demons of the body when you consume the Ayahuasca.
I closed my eyes at one point and for a fraction of a second had a very profound CEV of an alien. It was Yellow matter custard (From I am the Walrus by the Beatles) and had two purple eyes. Yet only one eye was significant. It took up the majority of half the face whilst the other eye remained normal. It had no other facial features and I can recall a tall red rock pillar behind it. The eye was full of galaxies and the whole universe. I then opened my eyes and drew what is now forever burned into my mind.
T+2:00 Good feelings of well being and a sense of excitement at being alive come like liquid.
T+2:00 Good feelings of well being and a sense of excitement at being alive come like liquid.
An overall energized feeling especially in my legs. T+3:00 Some friends came and forced me to go with them, my horoscope I read earlier in the day suggested something along the lines so I went with the flow. It was good to be with friends and see the beauty of the world. We did a little truck mudding which was exciting.
Around T+4:00 I smoked some cannabis. I was also beginning to feel nearly baseline at this time. I feel the cannabis muddled my thinking a bit but made conversation between individuals a little sharper. The trip was over at T+5:30. A noticeable leaving but a very smooth transition back into normal thinking.
There was a good afterglow feeling till about T+11:00. Overall I had a fantastic trip and see many possibilities of this substance. With time I shall continue my use and research and desire to submit further reports in hopes it shall aid in the further awareness and understanding of this field.
